purpose: Teach: 伴わ/望め/不運/奨め/ドンドン/浮かび上がっ/不機嫌/塗る

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが家族を伴わずに出張された
lines.en: Gran, when your father was young, he traveled for work without taking the family.
lines.style: Soft, measured opening. Voice drifts slightly distant — looking back through time. Slow, careful pace. Gentle sadness, not regret. Trailing off gently, inviting her in.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん、お祖父ちゃん、お孫様にいい暮らしを望めるよう尽くされたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Yes — your grandfather worked so hard to give your grandchildren a good life, didn't he, dear?
lines.style: Warm recognition, almost reflective. Speaking to him as much as confirming. Gentle affection woven through. Soft close on the final word, like she's laying a hand on his arm.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんは不運な時代を耐えられた
lines.en: Gran, your father endured such difficult times when he was young.
lines.style: Voice grows quieter, more weighted. Slower still. The weight of what he's remembering settles in. Breath of sadness on the middle words. Trailing off into reverence for what was borne.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、お孫様に古い詩集を奨められたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Your grandfather recommended that old poetry collection to your grandchildren, remember, dear?
lines.style: Gently redirecting with warmth. Acknowledging the weight he carries but steering toward the gifts he gave. Steady and sure. A soft insistence that beauty was also there.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが太鼓をドンドン叩かれた
lines.en: Gran, when your father was young, he played the drums — beating them steadily, with joy.
lines.style: A lightness returns. The pace lifts slightly. Voice opens up a bit — almost like a small smile. The memory of the sound in his voice. Warm reminiscence now, not just weight.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、記憶が今でも浮かび上がってくるわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Your grandfather, those memories still come floating back to you even now, don't they, dear?
lines.style: Affirming and knowing. She's naming what he's doing — the act of remembering itself. Tender but clear-eyed. The close nestles with affection, like she's witnessed this many times before.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんは不機嫌な顔をされなかった
lines.en: Gran, your father never wore a bitter expression, even in those hard times.
lines.style: Voice steadies with something like pride. A quiet certainty underneath. The pace is deliberate — each word placed with care. Slight breath before the close, like acknowledging a kind of grace.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、お孫様と一緒に絵に色を塗る姿を覚えてるわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Your grandfather, you remember painting pictures with your grandchildren, don't you, dear?
lines.style: Warm and almost playful now. The final memory is tender but alive. Close the phrase with quiet joy — the image of hands painting together. A whisper of a smile in her voice. The affection is palpable.
